newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuba to consider Colombian extradition request.
newsitem.headline: Cuba to consider Colombian extradition request.

text.p: Cuba said on Thursday it would consider a request from Colombia to extradite the husband of a prominent congresswoman and supporter of President Ernesto Samper who is wanted on fraud and corruption charges in Bogota.
"We have just received the request and we will be examining it," Cuba's acting Foreign Ministry spokesman, Alejandro Gonzalez, told a news briefing in Havana.

Colombia is seeking the extradition of Hernando Rodriguez, who is accused of a multimillion-dollar fraud and has been on the run since August. His wife, Martha Catalina Daniels, is one of Samper's staunchest supporters in the Colombian Congress.
